name: CISA KEV
description_en: Actively exploited CVEs — auto-escalates to CRITICAL.
help: Catalogue des vulnerabilites activement exploitees (Known Exploited Vulnerabilities) maintenu par la CISA. Si une CVE detectee figure dans ce catalogue, elle est automatiquement escaladee en CRITICAL. Aucune cle API requise, donnees publiques en JSON.
help_en: Catalog of actively exploited vulnerabilities (Known Exploited Vulnerabilities) maintained by CISA. If a detected CVE appears in this catalog, it is automatically escalated to CRITICAL. No API key required, public data in JSON.
